description: Save a structured checkpoint (summary, git state, next queue, open flags, track/lease metadata) for lossless handoffs. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

branch.description: Branch name persisted with the checkpoint

commit.description: Commit hash persisted with the checkpoint

crystallize.description: Optional: crystallize converged session decisions into a linked codex memory record (default false)

lease_id.description: Claimed scope lease_id that remains held at this handoff

summary.description: High-density summary of decisions, state, and findings

tests_green.description: Whether the test suite was green at checkpoint time.

track.description: Optional track slug persisted with the checkpoint

name: session.checkpoint
title: Session Checkpoint
